resume_policy.if_live_head_is_descendant: ingest commits after source_scientific_head before continuing

required_final_contract: universal progress or polynomial terminal recognition
polynomially bounded intermediate size and step count

current_research_state.carrier: post-series connected linear-cubic Exact-One source represented by distinct nonzero binary-kernel signatures; every source row is a projective line {u,v,u+v} and SAT is existence of a hyperplane containing no source line
established: Exact-One SAT iff mu(A)=n/3, equivalently the rooted minimum-circuit threshold in M_F2([A|1]).

All previously certified polynomial terminals remain active: full rational rank/low rational nullity, balanced, commuting/abelian, phase-pass, perfect-conflict, genuine small separators, single-odd rooted matroid terminals, and other frozen E9/E10 terminals.
Polynomial-dimensional bilinear annihilation summaries are impossible in the scoped witness-selection model: m independent polarity channels have connection rank 2^m.
Direct endpoint projected-delta-matroid encodings fail on all 42 perfect-matching normalizations of AFFINE_3X3.
Rooted and nonroot 2-cocircuit series pairs admit exact polynomial weighted contraction with witness lifting; SAT_12_3 collapses to a constant AG(3,2) core.
For K=ker_F2(A), equal kernel signatures are exactly nonroot series classes and zero signatures are exactly root-series classes.
After exhaustive series contraction all surviving signatures are distinct and nonzero; a surviving row has signatures {u,v,u+v}, a projective line in PG(k-1,2).
Every parity solution is x_j=1+sigma_j dot t. Exact-One holds iff no source projective line is contained in H_t={u:u dot t=0}.
Equivalently SAT asks for t outside the union of codimension-two orthogonal subspaces of the source lines.
Generic 2-SUB-SAT / union-of-subspace avoidance is NP-hard; only source-specific 3-regular linear projective-line geometry or a stronger global contraction remains admissible.
Series-irreducible PG(3,2) controls include both SAT and UNSAT instances; series-irreducibility alone is not a decision certificate.
No unconditional deterministic polynomial SAT decider has been established.

primary.goal: Construct a deterministic polynomial global contraction or zero-test for the 3-regular projective-line hyperplane-avoidance residual, with exact witness lifting and a strict polynomial progress measure.

secondary.goal: Exploit the exact Walsh/incidence form of the bad-line count without enumerating 2^k characters; reject any method that is only generic sparse-Fourier minimization or nearest-codeword in disguise.

reserve.goal: Import an external polynomial donor only after exact source audit and hostile-control validation.

next_attack: Derive the exact bad-line counting identity for a character t using 3-regular projective-line incidence and test whether equality q(t)=0 has a source-specific polynomial certificate.

Search current literature for algorithms or hardness specific to 3-regular projective-line / partial-Steiner parallel-class objects; do not import degree-at-most-3 hardness as exact degree-3 without proof.
Test any Fourier/spectral or projective contraction first on the frozen series-irreducible PG15 SAT and UNSAT controls and on high-girth/high-nullity source families.
If the Walsh zero-test is only generic codeword optimization, freeze that route and move to a genuinely representation-changing contraction on the projective arrangement.
Promote E8_D1 only after SOUND+COMPLETE+TERMINATES+POLY+RECONSTRUCT hold for arbitrary 3CNF.
